messages:
Sasha K: Heads-up — PR #6123 (hotfix: cache invalidation) is queued for the 11:30 UTC release window. We need 2x LGTM before 11:10 to make cutoff. CI is flaky but passing now. @Ken L @Alex T can you take a quick look?

Ken L: On it. Are the failing tests from yesterday still flaky?

Sasha K: CI = green on main job:
```
✅ unit-tests: pass
✅ integration: pass
✅ e2e: flaky but green on rerun #3
```
Failing e2e was timeout in the redis fixture, I bumped the timeout and added a retry.

Maria P: I can give an LGTM after reviewing the small rename in cache.go — will do in 5m. Minor nit: comment alignment.

Alex T: I'll review now. If it looks good I'll approve and add the QA check note.

Ken L: Reviewing now; if no functional changes beyond retry/timeout I'll LGTM.

Sasha K: Thanks — ping me once you approve. If we miss the cutoff we'll stage in the next window (+2h). :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

release-bot: Deploy window for 11:30 UTC closes at 11:10 UTC per schedule.

Alex T: LGTM — code looks fine, tests reran clean. Approving in GitHub.

Ken L: LGTM as well. Merging on redwood/repo#6123. :shipit: 

Sasha K: Merged and promoted to canary. Thanks everyone, monitoring logs now.

Maria P: Verified canary traces look healthy. No error spikes.

Sasha K: Closing thread — will follow up in incidents if anything pops.
